hero.title: The open-source app
hero.subtitle: Orkpad replaces the broken Excel, the outdated Notion, and the WhatsApp reminders. Clients, projects, time, and billing — in one place, under your control.

workflow.title: From lead to payment, under your control
workflow.description: From the first contact to the final invoice — without jumping between tools or losing context.

capture.title: Capture

contract.title: Plan

execute.desc: Integrated time tracking to know exactly what's performing, what's delaying, and what you can bill with confidence.

liquidate.title: Close

isolation.title: Workspace isolation:

export.title: Open formats:

backups.title: Self-hostable backups:

advanced.title: Built for real workflows.

subscriptions.title: Automated reports
subscriptions.desc: Your clients receive a summary every time you close tasks. Without you having to remember.

catalog.title: Client portal

agenda.title: Smart agenda

terms.title: DATA PRIVACY AND SECURITY POLICY
terms.intro: Welcome to Orkpad. This document details our unwavering commitment to the security of your professional infrastructure and the privacy of your digital assets.

sections.title: 1. Data Ownership Commitment
sections.content: In Orkpad, the user (freelancer or company) is the sole owner of the uploaded information. We act solely as data processors. Under no circumstances will we sell, rent, or use your information or that of your clients for purposes other than the technical operation of the platform.

sections.title: 2. Information Collection
sections.content: For optimal tool operation, we collect: 1) Registration Information (Name, email, and credentials); 2) Operational Data (Projects, tasks, and clients entered); 3) Diagnostic Data (Error logs and anonymous metrics for optimization).

sections.title: 3. Security and Technical Safeguards
sections.content: We implement enterprise-grade measures: Encryption in Transit (HTTPS/TLS), Encryption at Rest (AES-256), Environment Isolation (Multi-tenant architecture for total logical isolation), and automatic encrypted backups.

sections.title: 4. Use of Artificial Intelligence
sections.content: Data sent to AI models is processed ephemerally. We guarantee that your business data is NOT used to train third-party AI models or global models of our platform.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Integrations
sections.content: When connecting external tools, we only request the strictly necessary permissions. You can revoke these accesses at any time from your account settings.

sections.title: 6. Portability and Deletion
sections.content: Right to Export: Download your information in JSON or CSV whenever you want. Right to be Forgotten: Upon cancellation, we will permanently delete your data within a maximum of 30 days, except for legal accounting requirements.

sections.title: 7. Payments and Subscriptions
sections.content: Payment processing is carried out through PCI-DSS certified platforms. We do not store card numbers or bank keys in our systems.

sections.title: 8. Confidentiality
sections.content: Files and documents uploaded from your own clients are protected by the same rigor and security protocols as your own personal data.

summary.title: User Summary
items: Your data is yours: We only store it so you can work.
Security: We use the same standards as banks (AES-256).
Transparency: If you leave us, you take your data and we delete it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Orkpad ("we", "us", or "our"), operated by the Orkpad community, collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our platform at orkpad.com. By using Orkpad, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

s1.title: 1. Data We Collect
s1.intro: We collect the following categories of information:
s1.accountText: When you register, we collect your name, email address, and a securely hashed password (we never store your plain-text password). If you sign in via Google or GitHub OAuth, we receive your public profile information (name, email, and avatar) from those providers.
s1.workspaceText: All content you create within Orkpad — clients, projects, tasks, invoices, quotes, time entries, notes, documents, and any other records — is stored and associated with your workspace. This data belongs to you.
s1.usageText: We may collect technical information such as IP addresses, browser type, device information, and general usage patterns (page views, feature interactions) to operate, improve, and secure the service.
s1.integrationsText: If you connect Orkpad to Google (Calendar, Gmail) or GitHub, we receive and store OAuth access tokens and the data you explicitly authorize those integrations to access (e.g., calendar events, repository information). You can revoke these integrations at any time from your settings.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
s2.serviceText: To operate your workspace, display your data, and enable all Orkpad features.
s2.authText: To verify your identity, protect your account, and detect fraudulent activity.
s2.emailsText: To send verification emails, password reset links, and important system notifications (e.g., task reminders, follow-up alerts).
s2.syncText: To synchronize data with Google Calendar, Gmail, and GitHub as authorized by you.
s2.improvementText: To understand how users interact with the platform and fix issues.
s2.noSell: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We do not use your data for advertising.

s3.title: 3. Third-Party Services
s3.intro: Orkpad relies on the following third-party providers to operate. Each provider processes data according to their own privacy policies:
s3.googleDesc: Used for OAuth authentication (sign in with Google), Google Calendar synchronization, and Gmail integration. When you connect your Google account, Google shares your profile information and, if authorized, calendar and email send permissions with us.
s3.githubDesc: Used for OAuth authentication (sign in with GitHub) and repository integrations (listing repos, viewing commits and pull requests within Orkpad projects). We only access the repositories you authorize.
s3.railwayDesc: Orkpad's backend infrastructure is hosted on Railway. Your data is stored on Railway's servers. Railway may collect infrastructure-level logs and metrics.
s3.resendDesc: We use Resend to deliver transactional emails (account verification, password reset, notifications). Resend processes your email address and the content of these messages.
s3.mongoDesc: All Orkpad workspace data is stored in MongoDB Atlas, a cloud database service. Data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

s4.title: 4. Cookies & Local Storage
s4.intro: Orkpad uses browser storage for the following purposes:
s4.sessionText: We store JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in local storage to keep you authenticated between sessions. These tokens expire automatically (access tokens after a short period; refresh tokens after 7 days).
s4.prefsText: We store your selected theme (dark/light) and language (English/Spanish) locally so your preferences persist across visits.
s4.noTrackingText: We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking cookies, or analytics cookies from third parties.
s4.clear: You can clear your browser's local storage at any time to remove all session data. This will log you out of Orkpad.

s5.title: 5. Web Push Notifications
s5.p1: Orkpad offers optional browser push notifications for task reminders and important alerts. This feature uses the Web Push Protocol (VAPID standard) and requires your explicit opt-in via your browser's permission dialog.
s5.p2: If you enable push notifications, your browser generates a push subscription endpoint that is stored on our servers to deliver notifications to your device. You can revoke this permission at any time from your browser settings or from your Orkpad notification preferences, and we will delete your push subscription from our servers.
s5.p3: No personally identifiable information is shared with browser vendors through push notifications beyond what your browser already provides to operate the feature.

s6.title: 6. Data Security
s6.intro: We implement the following security measures to protect your data:
s6.isolationText: Orkpad is a multi-tenant platform. Every database query is strictly scoped to your workspace — your data is never accessible to other workspaces.
s6.transitText: All communication between your browser and Orkpad servers uses HTTPS/TLS encryption.
s6.hashingText: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt before storage. We never store or log plain-text passwords.
s6.tokensText: Authentication uses short-lived JWT access tokens paired with longer-lived refresh tokens, reducing the risk of token theft.
s6.dbEncryptionText: Data is encrypted at rest in MongoDB Atlas.
s6.disclaimer: Despite these measures, no system is completely immune to security incidents. In the event of a data breach affecting your personal information, we will notify you as required by applicable law.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights
s7.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
s7.accessText: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
s7.correctionText: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
s7.deletionText: Request deletion of your account and associated personal data. Workspace business data (clients, projects, invoices, etc.) will also be deleted upon account deletion.
s7.exportText: Request an export of your data in a portable format.
s7.objectionText: Object to certain types of processing.
s7.revokeText: Disconnect Google or GitHub integrations at any time from your account settings, revoking our access to those services.
s7.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}. We will respond within 30 days.

s8.title: 8. Data Retention
s8.p1: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with the service. If you delete your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal information within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it for legal, tax, or regulatory compliance purposes.
s8.p2: Workspace business data (such as invoices and financial records) that you have generated may be retained for up to 7 years after account deletion solely to comply with applicable accounting and tax regulations, after which it will be permanently deleted.

s9.title: 9. Children's Privacy
s9.text: Orkpad is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided us with personal data, please contact us at {email} and we will delete that information promptly.

s10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
s10.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. When we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page and, if the changes are significant, notify you by email or via a notice within the Orkpad platform.
s10.p2: Your continued use of Orkpad after the effective date of any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.
